verdict.rationale: Granola's API docs name this exact use case, extracting action items from notes and creating tasks in Linear or Jira. The product also exposes a REST API with a webhook-endpoints resource, plus a Zapier integration for post-meeting automation. However, there is no native Linear, Jira, or Asana integration: the user or agent must build the extraction and task-filing pipeline, and API keys require a Business or Enterprise plan. Missing for 10: a native project-tracker integration or turnkey automation, documented webhook event details for meeting-completed triggers, a documented action-item field or endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can automatically file each meeting's action items into my project tracker (Linear, Jira, Asana) using the product's API, webhooks, or native automations

citations.quote: Extract action items from meeting notes and automatically create tasks in Linear, Jira, Todoist, or your project management tool of choice.
